import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import lightgbm as lgb
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
import os

# Ensure output directory exists
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

# Load datasets
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_sub = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")

target_col = "target"
id_col = "id"

# Prepare features and target
X_train = train_df.drop([id_col, target_col], axis=1)
y_train = train_df[target_col]
X_test = test_df.drop(id_col, axis=1)

# Smooth target encoding for high-cardinality feature f_27
cat_col = "f_27"
k = 10
global_mean = y_train.mean()
group_stats = X_train.groupby(cat_col)[y_train.name].agg(["mean", "count"])
smoothed_map = (
    (group_stats["count"] * global_mean + group_stats["mean"] * k)
    / (group_stats["count"] + k)
).rename(cat_col + "_enc")

# Apply encoding to train and test sets
X_train = X_train.assign(**{cat_col + "_enc": X_train[cat_col].map(smoothed_map)})
X_test = X_test.assign(
    **{cat_col + "_enc": X_test[cat_col].map(smoothed_map).fillna(global_mean)}
)

# Drop original string column
X_train = X_train.drop(cat_col, axis=1)
X_test = X_test.drop(cat_col, axis=1)

# Hold-out validation split
X_tr, X_val, y_tr, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train, y_train, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=y_train
)

# Initialize LightGBM classifier
lgb_model = lgb.LGBMClassifier(
    objective="binary",
    metric="auc",
    learning_rate=0.05,
    num_leaves=63,
    max_depth=7,
    n_estimators=1000,
    min_child_samples=20,
    subsample=0.8,
    colsample_bytree=0.8,
    verbose=False,
    random_state=42,
)

# Train on validation split with early stopping
lgb_model.fit(X_tr, y_tr, eval_set=[(X_val, y_val)], early_stopping_rounds=50)

# Evaluate on genuine hold-out validation set
val_probs = lgb_model.predict_proba(X_val)[:, 1]
val_auc = roc_auc_score(y_val, val_probs)
print(f"Validation AUC-ROC: {val_auc:.5f}")

# Train final model on full training data for submission
final_model = lgb.LGBMClassifier(
    objective="binary",
    metric="auc",
    learning_rate=0.05,
    num_leaves=63,
    max_depth=7,
    n_estimators=1000,
    min_child_samples=20,
    subsample=0.8,
    colsample_bytree=0.8,
    verbose=False,
    random_state=42,
)
final_model.fit(X_train, y_train)

# Generate predictions on test set
test_probs = final_model.predict_proba(X_test)[:, 1]

# Create and save submission
submission = pd.DataFrame({id_col: sample_sub[id_col], target_col: test_probs})
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print("Submission saved successfully.")
